issues_detected.description: Internal tension on MDA-MB-468 Perturb-seq coverage: the description states the release covers 'single-cell CRISPRi Perturb-seq for MDA-MB-468 cells with and without treatment' and all three MDA-MB-468 subsets claim 'Perturb-seq data for the [un]treated condition', yet file_collections lists only KOLF2 Perturb-seq archives (atlas and raw_sra) and third_party_sharing states 'the Perturb-seq deposits for KOLF2.1J iPSCs and for MDA-MB-468 cells are listed as embargoed'
issues_detected.recommendation: Clarify whether MDA-MB-468 Perturb-seq data are inside a distributed archive or only referenced as embargoed external deposits, and align description, subsets, and file_collections

issues_detected.description: cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_raw_sra.zip is described as a 'Raw sequence data package' but is listed at 73.3 KB, which is implausibly small for raw single-cell sequencing reads and is more consistent with a manifest or pointer package; the record reproduces the source description without noting the discrepancy
issues_detected.recommendation: Note that the archive likely contains SRA submission metadata or pointers rather than raw reads, or verify its contents

issues_detected.description: Donor-level consent provenance for the two source cell lines (MDA-MB-468 from ATCC, KOLF2.1J from HipSci) is not documented; direct_collection states 'both cell lines have been ethically sourced' per the preprint but records no consent framework
issues_detected.recommendation: If available in source documentation, record cell-line donor consent provenance (e.g., the HipSci consent framework, ATCC terms) under direct_collection or raw_data_sources.access_details

issues_detected.description: ethical_reviews documents the CM4AI Ethics Module, two named contacts, and the Value-Sensitive Design methodology, but does not address conflicts of interest; participant compensation and at-risk-population slots are negated only implicitly (via direct_collection.is_direct=false) rather than by explicit statement
issues_detected.recommendation: State whether conflicts of interest were assessed (or that none were declared), and explicitly note that compensation and at-risk-population procedures do not apply because no individuals were enrolled

issues_detected.description: No variable-level metadata (variables slot absent) and no anomalies slot; is_tabular=false is correctly set for an archive-based release, but the tabular derived products inside the archives (Perturbation Cell Atlas, AP-MS/SEC-MS interaction tables) have column structures that are not described
issues_detected.recommendation: Add variable/column descriptions for the tabular derived products and document any known anomalies, outliers, or batch effects (or state that sources document none)

semantic_insights: DOI 10.18130/V3/HIGT4C uses the University of Virginia Dataverse (LibraData) prefix 10.18130, a known Dataverse registrar prefix, and is used consistently in id, doi, page, citation, file_collections fragment IDs, and version_access

Cell line RRIDs (CVCL_0419 for MDA-MB-468, CVCL_B5P3 for KOLF2.1J) are valid Cellosaurus format and match the named lines

Arithmetic consistency: total_file_count=10 matches the 10 file_collections entries, each carrying an MD5 checksum and human-readable size; byte counts are deliberately not asserted because 'no exact byte counts are given by any source' (source_caveats item 8)

human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects=false is consistently propagated: direct_collection explains that no individuals were enrolled, is_deidentified documents the cell-line de-identification rationale ('cannot be matched, with current knowledge, to a human subject'), sensitive_elements records absence with reasoning, and regulatory_restrictions confirms 'samples are de-identified'

Exceptional source-conflict transparency: source_caveats records eight numbered disagreements resolved by a declared source ranking, including the 2025-vs-2026 release-date conflict, the 464/563/523 protein-count disagreement, the Sali affiliation conflict, and the decision not to merge 'Parker J' with 'Jillian Mohan'

The 'Administration directives' review notice on both the portal and the Dataverse collection is captured under regulatory_restrictions.other_compliance and retention_details

sub_elements.quality_note: Documentation, tutorials, and a concrete training event are all linked, with named contacts for project and website inquiries

sub_elements.name: Related Datasets with Typed Relationships
sub_elements.evidence: is_new_version_of (October 2025, doi:10.18130/V3/K7TGEM) and continues (June 2025 doi:10.18130/V3/F3TD5R, March 2025 doi:10.18130/V3/B35XWX), each with DOI, version, and contents summary
sub_elements.quality_note: Typed lineage of the quarterly release series with per-release content deltas; the May 2024 release appears only in version_access prose

strengths: Verified-identifier density: valid UVA Dataverse DOI used consistently across id/doi/page/citation and subset/file fragment IDs, valid NIH grant numbers with RePORTER-level detail (award amount, period, supplement), valid Cellosaurus RRIDs for both cell lines, ORCIDs for 36 of 47 creators, and a ROR-identified publisher

Internally consistent structure: total_file_count=10 matches the 10 file_collections entries, every distributed archive carries an MD5 checksum, and byte counts are deliberately withheld because no source states them (source_caveats item 8)

Coherent handling of the no-human-subjects case: involves_human_subjects=false is propagated through direct_collection, is_deidentified, sensitive_elements, and regulatory_restrictions, with explicit non-applicability of IRB approval and an explicit re-identification assessment

Systematic source-conflict transparency: eight numbered source_caveats resolved by a declared source ranking, including the 2025-vs-2026 release-date conflict, the 464/563/523 protein-count disagreement, the Sali affiliation conflict, the unmerged Parker/Mohan identity, and the exclusion of the U2OS Nature paper's measurements from this record

Complete provenance and version story: typed release lineage with per-release DOIs and content deltas, quarterly update schedule through November 2026, a concrete erratum, raw-vs-derived separation across MassIVE/SRA/Figshare deposits, and RO-Crate/EVI provenance packaging
weaknesses: No variable-level metadata: the 'variables' slot is absent and the column structures of tabular derived products (Perturbation Cell Atlas, interaction tables) are undescribed, even though the record notes JSON-Schema data-dictionaries exist inside the RO-Crate packages (costs Elements 3.4 and 5.3)
No anomalies documentation: beyond missing-data coverage gaps, no release-level anomaly, outlier, or batch-effect information is recorded (costs Element 9.3)

Internal tension on MDA-MB-468 Perturb-seq: the description and all three MDA-MB-468 subsets claim Perturb-seq coverage while file_collections lists only KOLF2 Perturb-seq archives and third_party_sharing records the MDA-MB-468 deposit as embargoed

Donor-level consent provenance for the two source cell lines is not documented beyond the preprint's 'ethically sourced' characterization, and compensation/at-risk-population non-applicability is implicit rather than explicitly stated
Conflicts of interest are not addressed in ethical_reviews, and no dedicated per-file download URLs are recorded
recommendations: Add a 'variables' section describing the column structure of the tabular derived products, or surface the JSON-Schema mini-data-dictionaries that the RO-Crate packages already contain
Reconcile the MDA-MB-468 Perturb-seq claim: state explicitly whether those data are inside a distributed archive, external-only, or embargoed, and align description, subsets, and file_collections
Add an anomalies entry covering known QC outcomes, outliers, or batch effects for the released archives (or an explicit statement that the sources document none)
Record cell-line donor consent provenance (ATCC terms, HipSci consent framework) and explicitly negate compensation/at-risk-population applicability in direct_collection

State whether conflicts of interest were assessed in ethical_reviews, clarify the contents of the 73.3 KB 'raw sequence data package', and add per-file Dataverse Data Access API URLs to distribution_formats

evaluation_timestamp_basis: stamped at write time (~23:30Z) by the resumed session; this evaluator re-ran its final assembly after the 20:53Z connection drop rather than reusing a pre-drop stamp, so analysis and write time coincide.
